column3: How many hours per week are employees expected to work?
column4: Employees are expected to work 40 hours per week [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

column3: What are the standard working hours from Monday through Friday?
column4: Standard working hours are from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

column3: During what time range may flexible working hours be permitted with manager approval?
column4: Flexible working hours may be permitted between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM with manager approval [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

column3: Who must approve overtime in advance?
column4: Overtime must be approved in advance by the employee’s direct supervisor [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1]. All overtime requires advance approval [Source: employee-handbook-01.pdf, page: 17].

column3: How many days per week may employees work remotely?
column4: Employees are allowed to work remotely up to 2 days per week [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

column3: What secure connection must employees use to access internal resources remotely?
column4: Employees must connect through the company VPN when accessing internal resources remotely [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].
